notes: Tessellate: a runaway Concord repair swarm that woke up (standard rig). A person-shaped swarm of tiny bots: each bot is a 2x2 block of steel with a 1 px GAP of floor between neighbours (pitch 3), a few with a cyan status light or an amber work lamp, the eyes two lit bots, a sash of bots in the outfit colour, and a couple of strays hovering off the body. The outline is drawn round the outside of the swarm only, so the gaps between bots stay open (floor shows through). Arms and legs are trails of bots. torso_glow (2 frames, ~3 fps) is the status lights chasing each other. Head variants: swarm (default, one bot floating above), visor (a lit strip), helmet (a tinted crown of bots). Outfit mask = the sash and the bot before each hand. `tessellate_half` is the 1x1 body it splits into. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
